name: Armature Art 12
driverConfig: 12BA (4-in-1 bass module + 4 mid BA + 4-in-1 treble module)
pros: Solid build with engraved aluminum faceplate
cons: Very low impedance requires good source control
Thick shell may not suit all ears
Tuning is warmer/bass-forward rather than reference
insight: Moondrop's 12-driver all-BA flagship from the Armature Art series. Uses a balanced 4+4+4 three-way configuration with custom 4-in-1 bass and treble modules. Known for a warm, weighty presentation that is unusual for pure BA designs, with smooth treble and good coherence.
